description:
Every stored Polymarket market of one event_slug: the moneyline, spreads, totals, team totals, half and quarter lines, player props and the rest, plus the markets of the event's child events (a soccer game's exact score, halftime result and more-markets events), each with its own event_slug. Each row carries the condition_id, the provider's sports_market_type and groupItemTitle, the provider's typed line and, when stated, the outcome index it belongs to, both outcome labels with their CLOB token ids, and active or closed status. Ordered by sports_market_type, then line, then condition_id. Pass a condition_id to get_market_holders, get_market_flow or get_market_snapshot.

Args:
  - event_slug (string, required): the event slug from list_games, get_game or a search_markets result, for example nba-bos-orl-2026-11-01. Matched case-insensitively. Live, upcoming and settled events all answer
  - sports_market_type (string, optional): comma-separated provider market types to keep, case-insensitive (spreads, totals, points, first_half_totals). Omitted keeps every type; an unknown type returns an empty page
  - status (string, optional): active, closed or all (default all)
  - limit (number, 1-100, default 20)
  - cursor (string, optional): opaque gmk_v1_ cursor from next_cursor, sent with the same filters
  - expand (string[], optional): sharp_money adds each row's sharp_money: status (computed, not_computed or unavailable; the first read of a game can be unavailable while its split is built, so retry after a few seconds), trader_count, per-outcome usd and S/A/B wallet counts, and money_as_of, the game page's per-line split

Returns: data, has_more, next_cursor, event_slug, families and meta. families lists every market type the event holds with its market and active counts, whatever the filters: read it first to choose a sports_market_type. A slug no stored market carries answers 404; an event outside sports and esports answers 404 with reason market_out_of_scope. Carries no price and no holder identity: get_game_holders reads the holders of several of these markets in one call.

cursor.description: Opaque gmk_v1_ cursor from next_cursor, used with the same filters

event_slug.description: The game's event slug, for example nba-bos-orl-2026-11-01; matched case-insensitively

expand.description: sharp_money adds each row's sharp-money split: side USD and S/A/B wallet counts per outcome (#32155)

sports_market_type.description: Comma-separated provider market types to keep, case-insensitive: spreads, totals, points, first_half_totals. Omitted keeps every type; the response's families lists the event's types

status.description: Keep only active or only closed markets; default all

name: list_game_markets
title: List a game's markets
